flat_type_hierarchy_index_html.root_cause: the reported '1.7:1' in the original detector snippet described the overall min-to-max span, not any single adjacent-step ratio; the real adjacent-step ratios were 16/14=1.143, 20/16=1.25, 24/20=1.2 -- two of three steps were below a clean 1.25 floor
flat_type_hierarchy_index_html.fix: rescaled the token set to 12/16/20/26px (0.75rem/1rem/1.25rem/1.625rem), giving adjacent ratios 1.333, 1.25, 1.3 -- every adjacent step now at or above 1.25
flat_type_hierarchy_index_html.note: this is an arithmetic correction to values DESIGN.md already declared as the intended target ("ratio 1.25-1.33"), not a new design decision

flat_type_hierarchy_proposal_html.root_cause: proposal.html's inline <style> block used ad hoc rem values (0.85rem, 0.92rem, 0.94rem, 0.96rem, 1rem, 1.1rem, 1.15rem, 1.5rem) independently of styles.css's token scale, producing 8 near-duplicate sizes with several adjacent gaps under 1.05:1
flat_type_hierarchy_proposal_html.fix: replaced every literal font-size in proposal.html's <style> block with the same six var(--text-*) tokens now defined in that block's own :root (mirroring styles.css's corrected scale), collapsing 8 near-duplicate sizes down to the shared 4-flat-step + 2-fluid-clamp scale
flat_type_hierarchy_proposal_html.note: this is the same shared-scale consolidation already applied to styles.css in this pass, extended to proposal.html's independent style surface
